test_get_container_exec_info_returns_met: test get_container_exec_info reads .container-mode metadata and returns backend, container_name, exec_user, hermes_bin fields
test_exec_in_container_calls_execvp: test _exec_in_container calls os.execvp with docker runtime, exec command, tty flags, user, env vars, container name, binary, and CLI args
test_exec_in_container_non_tty_uses_i_on: test _exec_in_container uses -i flag instead of -it when stdin is not a TTY
test_exec_in_container_sudo_probe_sets_p: test _exec_in_container falls back to sudo prefix when direct runtime probe fails but sudo probe succeeds
test_exec_in_container_no_runtime_hard_f: test _exec_in_container exits with error when container runtime is not found on the system
